svg.title: sand-agent: a live agent chat about Kyle Touchet, typed from public GitHub history
svg.desc: Q: hey, who's Sand? Kyle Touchet, better known around here as Sand. Software Engineer and Creative Technologist. Over ten years in IT operations and federal-sector administration, now designing and shipping production web, desktop and AI applications end to end. The headline act is LadderStar: a live AI interview platform with a real-time, voice-to-voice audition room built on Google's Gemini Multimodal Live API. Q: is Sand open to work? Yes. Sand is looking for work right now, as a software engineer or creative technologist. The pitch: production web, desktop and AI apps shipped end to end, on top of ten years of IT operations and federal-sector work handling sensitive identity data under strict privacy rules. Say hi at kyletouchet@gmail.com or kyletouchet.dev. Q: where did Sand's IT career start? Years of hands-on IT before the federal work: 2019 Audubon Institute IT Specialist 2018-19 Treasure Chest Casino Technician II 2015-18 Gameloft IT & Hardware Manager 2011-14 Seatrax Marine Cranes IT / Quality Control Highlights: render farms and test-device fleets at a game studio, Windows servers under state gaming rules, and a full network deployed for a company acquisition. Q: hold on, airship mods? Two published mods for Create: Aeronautics, on CurseForge and Modrinth: procedural delivery contracts with physics-compiled cargo, and a preflight tool that simulates mass, lift, balance and thrust torque.
